what: the port's fused CUDA engine against its operators engine (AD6; ADR 0101; reported, never gated): update[sum], end_to_end and the per-batch times at the recorded lock, and the largest distance between their label bits

port.name: dyng-compat-dynlp
port.time_ms: a pair of CUDA events on the resources' stream around each public label_propagation::update() call (AD2); the host wall time of the call in dyng_times.csv

protocol.lock: perf.lock: declared held by the caller (--no-lock / DYNG_PERF_LOCK_HELD=1)
protocol.order: A/B/A/B: in every round one process per engine (fused, operators), the same session
protocol.argv: bench/run.sh's (--quiet --noValidate; files in a fresh per-round scratch directory) + --backend cuda --cuda-engine <engine>
protocol.clocks: the lock the baseline recorded per case (ADRs 0018, 0021)

clocks.how: ncu --clock-control boost on parity/clock_lock/clock_holder.cu (idle, one kernel) for the whole A/B; the timed programs are not profiled
clocks.check: every busy GPU sample of every accepted round at the locked clocks

guard.rule: each engine's per-batch counts and label bytes equal its first round's and the other engine's (AD6)
